changelog: v0.0.1: Major Expansion. Added 15+ features across 5 domains: Base Building (10x Altar Radius, Unlimited Altars, Free Blocks, No Stability), Item Spawner & Upgrader (item catalog, 0-rune upgrades, max perks), Combat (Infinite Arrows, Instant Bow Draw, Rapid Wands, One-Hit Kill), Exploration (Clear Shroud Fog, Waypoint Teleporter, Reveal Map Icons), and Progression (Free Skill Respec, Unlock All Recipes, Red Shroud Immunity).
v1.3.0: Added Building Fly Mode, Infinite Gliding, Jump Height, Walking Speed, Slope Mountain Walking, Dragged Item Quantity, and Fog of War Reveal Multiplier.
v1.2.0: Implemented hybrid client-server architecture with server-authoritative world rules and client-controlled personal cheats.
v1.1.0: Full user configurability with adjustable sliders and exact value limits.
v1.0.0: Initial release of SF Cheat Menu & Server Tweaks.

infiniteHealth.label: Infinite Health / God Mode (Personal)
infiniteHealth.description: Clamps Health_Min to current Health_Max for your character. You become immune to lethal damage.

healthRegenMultiplier.label: Health Regen Multiplier (Personal)
healthRegenMultiplier.description: Multiplies natural health regeneration rate for your character (1x = standard, up to 500x).

infiniteStamina.label: Infinite Stamina (Personal)
infiniteStamina.description: Locks stamina at maximum. Disables stamina drain for sprinting, fighting, and climbing.

staminaRegenMultiplier.label: Stamina Regen Multiplier (Personal)
staminaRegenMultiplier.description: Multiplies natural stamina regeneration rate (1x = standard, up to 500x).

infiniteMana.label: Infinite Mana (Personal)
infiniteMana.description: Locks mana at maximum. Spells and abilities consume zero mana.

manaRegenMultiplier.label: Mana Regen Multiplier (Personal)
manaRegenMultiplier.description: Multiplies natural mana regeneration rate (1x = standard, up to 500x).

freezeShroudTimer.label: Freeze Shroud Timer (Personal / World)
freezeShroudTimer.description: Halts the Miasma/Shroud timer for unlimited exploration inside the shroud.

shroudTimeMultiplier.label: Shroud Time Multiplier
shroudTimeMultiplier.description: Multiplies allowable shroud timer duration via shroudTimeFactor (1x = standard, up to 100x).

redShroudImmunity.label: Red Shroud Immunity / Deadly Miasma Passage (Personal)
redShroudImmunity.description: Grants complete immunity against deadly red lethal shroud zones, allowing exploration everywhere regardless of flame level.

maxComfort.label: Max Comfort Level (Personal)
maxComfort.description: Locks comfort to maximum value for the longest possible rested duration.

customComfortLevel.label: Custom Comfort Level (Personal)
customComfortLevel.description: Sets a custom comfort level (0 = original world comfort, up to 100 max).

noHypothermia.label: No Hypothermia / Cold Immunity (Personal)
noHypothermia.description: Maintains body heat at maximum; eliminates freezing in cold or snowy biomes.

infiniteOxygen.label: Infinite Oxygen / Diving Breath (Personal)
infiniteOxygen.description: Maintains oxygen reserve at maximum; prevents drowning while diving.

infiniteFocus.label: Infinite Focus (Personal)
infiniteFocus.description: Keeps focus resource full for special combat abilities and spells.

critChance.label: Critical Hit Chance % (Personal)
critChance.description: Additional critical hit chance percentage (0% to 100% max).

critDamageMultiplier.label: Critical Damage % (Personal)
critDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for critical strike damage (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

meleeDamageMultiplier.label: Melee Damage % (Personal)
meleeDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for melee weapon attacks (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

rangedDamageMultiplier.label: Ranged Damage % (Personal)
rangedDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for bows and thrown weapons (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

magicDamageMultiplier.label: Magic Damage % (Personal)
magicDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for staves, wands, and spells (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

oneHitKill.label: One-Hit Kill / Infinite Attack Damage (Personal)
oneHitKill.description: Deals lethal infinite damage on any enemy or boss hit, instantly defeating them.

personalZeroThreat.label: Enemies Ignore Me / Zero Threat (Personal)
personalZeroThreat.description: Individual stealth: zeroes your personal threat so enemies ignore you without affecting teammates.

infiniteArrows.label: Infinite Arrows & Ammo (Personal)
infiniteArrows.description: Shooting bows and projectile weapons consumes zero arrows and ammo from your inventory.

instantBowDraw.label: Instant Bow Draw & Rapid Fire (Personal)
instantBowDraw.description: Eliminates bow draw and arrow charge time for instantaneous, rapid-fire archery.

rapidWandCadence.label: Rapid Wand & Staff Attack Cadence (Personal)
rapidWandCadence.description: Removes spellcasting cooldown and attack recovery delay for machine-gun wand and staff fire.

buildFlyMode.label: Building Fly Mode (Zero Gravity & Hover)
buildFlyMode.description: Disables gravity and allows floating/flying in mid-air at any height for effortless building.

unlimitedGliding.label: Infinite Gliding (Unlimited Flight)
unlimitedGliding.description: Disables glider stamina drain and eliminates downward sink rate for unlimited flight.

jumpHeightMultiplier.label: Jump Height % (Personal)
jumpHeightMultiplier.description: Multiplier for jump height and distance (100% = default, up to 1000% super jump).

movementSpeedMultiplier.label: Movement Speed % (Walking & Running)
movementSpeedMultiplier.description: Multiplier for walking, running, and sprinting speed (100% = normal, up to 500%).

slopeWalking.label: Slope Walking (Climb Steep Mountains)
slopeWalking.description: Increases max walkable slope angle to 89 degrees and disables sliding down steep mountain cliffs.

unlimitedGrapplingHook.label: Unlimited Grappling Hook Range & Stamina (Personal)
unlimitedGrapplingHook.description: Expands grappling hook latch distance to ultra-long ranges and removes grapple stamina consumption.

teleportMapMarker.label: Teleport to Map Marker / Pin (Personal)
teleportMapMarker.description: Instantly teleports your character to your active custom waypoint marker pin placed on the map.

saveWaypointSlot1.label: Save Current Position as Waypoint (Slot 1)
saveWaypointSlot1.description: Saves your current 3D world coordinates (X, Y, Z) into Waypoint Slot 1.

teleportWaypointSlot1.label: Teleport to Saved Waypoint (Slot 1)
teleportWaypointSlot1.description: Teleports your character directly back to the coordinates saved in Waypoint Slot 1.

altarRadiusMultiplier.label: Flame Altar Build Radius Multiplier (World/Server)
altarRadiusMultiplier.description: Multiplies the protected building boundary radius of all Flame Altars (1x up to 10x / up to 500m).

unlimitedFlameAltars.label: Unlimited Flame Altars Placement (World/Server)
unlimitedFlameAltars.description: Removes the altar placement cap, allowing an unlimited number of Flame Altars world-wide.

freeBuildingBlocks.label: Free Building Blocks (Hammer Consumes 0 Materials)
freeBuildingBlocks.description: Placing walls, roofs, terrain shapes, and props with the Construction Hammer consumes zero blocks and materials.

ignoreStructuralStability.label: Ignore Structural Stability / Unrestricted Placement
ignoreStructuralStability.description: Disables structural integrity checks, allowing floating structures, steep overhangs, and clipping placement.

freeFlameUpgrades.label: Free Flame Altar Upgrades (World/Server)
freeFlameUpgrades.description: Upgrading the Flame Altar requires zero Sparks, Shroud Cores, or trophy materials.

infiniteDurability.label: Infinite Item Durability (World/Server)
infiniteDurability.description: Disables durability loss for all weapons, tools, and armor world-wide.

freeCrafting.label: Free Crafting (Server-Controlled)
freeCrafting.description: Allows crafting all recipes at workbenches and stations without requiring materials.

unlockAllRecipes.label: Unlock All Crafting Blueprints & Recipes (World/Server)
unlockAllRecipes.description: Unlocks every crafting recipe, workbench blueprint, furniture piece, and equipment schematic in the game.

itemAmountMultiplier.label: Item Drop & Yield Multiplier (World/Server)
itemAmountMultiplier.description: Multiplies item quantities dropped from harvesting, mining, and enemies (1x to 100x).

stackSizeMode.label: Stack Size Mode (World/Server)
stackSizeMode.description: Universal stack size mode: dynamic multiplier, custom fixed size, or 32,767 max preset.

stackSizeMultiplier.label: Stack Size Multiplier (World/Server)
stackSizeMultiplier.description: Multiplies the max stack size of all items (1x = default, up to 100x).

customStackSize.label: Custom Stack Size (World/Server)
customStackSize.description: Sets the stack size for all items to this exact value (up to 32,767 max safe limit).

editItemQuantity.label: Enable Dragged Item Quantity Override
editItemQuantity.description: Applies a custom stack quantity when dragging, splitting, or transferring items in your inventory.

customItemQuantity.label: Dragged Item Quantity
customItemQuantity.description: Desired stack amount applied when dragging or splitting items (1 to 32,767).

enableCustomInventory.label: Enable Custom Backpack Slots (Personal)
enableCustomInventory.description: Activates custom player backpack storage capacity without altering quickbars.

customInventorySlots.label: Backpack Storage Slots (Personal)
customInventorySlots.description: Number of available backpack storage slots (16 to 96 slots, 8 slots per row).

enableCustomContainer.label: Enable Custom Chest Slots (World/Server)
enableCustomContainer.description: Activates custom storage slot capacity for all placed and spawned chests/boxes.

customContainerSlots.label: Chest / Container Storage Slots (World/Server)
customContainerSlots.description: Number of storage slots for chests and boxes (16 to 96 slots, 8 slots per row).

freeWeaponUpgrades.label: Free Blacksmith Weapon Upgrades / 0 Runes (World/Server)
freeWeaponUpgrades.description: Enhancing and upgrading weapons at the Blacksmith costs zero Runes.

maxWeaponPerks.label: Instant Max Weapon Level & Perks (Personal/World)
maxWeaponPerks.description: Unlocks all weapon bonus perks and enchantment nodes to maximum level upon acquisition.

itemSpawnerCategory.label: Item Spawner Category
itemSpawnerCategory.description: Category of items to select and spawn directly into your backpack.

itemSpawnerItem.label: Item Spawner Selection
itemSpawnerItem.description: Item template to generate into inventory.

itemSpawnerAmount.label: Item Spawner Amount
itemSpawnerAmount.description: Quantity of the selected item to generate into your backpack.

triggerItemSpawn.label: Spawn Selected Item Now
triggerItemSpawn.description: Toggle on to generate the specified quantity into your inventory (automatically resets).

xpMultiplier.label: Experience (XP) Multiplier (World/Server)
xpMultiplier.description: Multiplies XP earned from combat, quests, and mining (1x = default, up to 100x).

infiniteSkillPoints.label: Free Skill Tree Unlocks (Server/Host)
infiniteSkillPoints.description: Sets skill point cost of all nodes in the skill tree to 0 for instant learning.

freeRespecAnywhere.label: Free Skill Respec Anywhere / 0 Runes (Personal)
freeRespecAnywhere.description: Allows resetting your skill tree anytime, anywhere directly from the character menu without an altar, costing 0 runes.

dumbEnemies.label: Pacify World Enemies (Server/Host AI)
dumbEnemies.description: World-wide pacification: enemies will not initiate attacks and are completely pacified.

enemyPerceptionMultiplier.label: Enemy Perception Range % (World/Server)
enemyPerceptionMultiplier.description: Detection and sight range of enemies (100% = normal, 0% = completely blind).

enemyDamageMultiplier.label: Enemy Damage % (World/Server)
enemyDamageMultiplier.description: Scales outgoing damage from all enemies (100% = default, 0% = zero damage).

freezeTimeOfDay.label: Freeze Time of Day (World/Server)
freezeTimeOfDay.description: Halts the day-night cycle progression at the current time.

gameSpeed.label: Game Speed % (World/Server)
gameSpeed.description: Game engine speed timescale (50% slow-mo to 300% fast-forward).

productionSpeedMultiplier.label: Production Station Speed (World/Server)
productionSpeedMultiplier.description: Speed multiplier for furnaces, kilns, drying racks, and workbenches (1x to 50x).

plantGrowthMultiplier.label: Plant & Crop Growth Speed (World/Server)
plantGrowthMultiplier.description: Speed multiplier for seedlings, farm plots, and tree growth (1x to 50x).

clearShroudVision.label: Clear Shroud Vision (Disable Blinding Fog)
clearShroudVision.description: Eliminates thick, blinding volumetric fog inside the Shroud for crystal clear panoramic vision.

revealAllMapIcons.label: Reveal All Map Icons / Shrines & Spires
revealAllMapIcons.description: Unveils all Flame Shrines, Spires, Elixir Wells, Obelisks, and points of interest across the entire map.

fogOfWarDiscoveryRange.label: Fog of War Reveal Multiplier (Minimap Radar)
fogOfWarDiscoveryRange.description: Dramatically expands map discovery radius (1x to 50x), instantly unveiling the world map and radar as you travel.

hudMinimapRadar.label: Enhanced Compass Radar & Landmark Reveal
hudMinimapRadar.description: Expands HUD compass detection radius to maximum, revealing all nearby points of interest and landmarks.

teleportKeyLocations.label: Key Location Fast Travel (Personal)
teleportKeyLocations.description: Unlocks direct fast travel and teleportation assistance to points of interest.

groups.label: Personal Player Attributes & Defense
groups.description: Individual client cheats toggled per player without affecting other server participants.

groups.label: Combat, Archery & Magic Spells
groups.description: Damage amplifiers, one-hit kill, infinite arrows, instant bow draw, and machine-gun wand spellcasting.

groups.label: Movement, Flight & Navigation
groups.description: Building fly mode, unlimited glider flight, jump height, movement speed, slope climbing, and grappling hook.

groups.label: Base Building & Construction
groups.description: Flame Altar radius multiplier up to 10x (500m), unlimited altars, free building blocks, and zero stability limits.

groups.label: Inventory, Stacks & Item Spawner
groups.description: Universal stack sizes, custom chest slots, infinite durability, free crafting, item quantity editor, and in-game item spawner.

groups.label: World, Server & Economy Rules
groups.description: Authoritative dedicated server rules synchronizing XP, free respec, and shroud multipliers.

groups.label: World Enemy AI & Difficulty
groups.description: Server-wide control over monster aggressiveness, detection range, and damage output.

groups.label: World Time, Radar & Exploration Vision
groups.description: Day/night freezing, timescale, clear shroud vision, reveal all map icons, and minimap radar reveal.
